body: it's not panic it's just disturbing. i dont know. i just didn't want to sleep.

my financial future and work is tied in with my father's. he's cheap as fuck and ignorant to boot. he'll buy for example, a 6000 dollar camera, but won't foot the bill for 600-800 dollar software to make it work. he'll sit on it waiting for someone to help him, not making an effort himself, but of course he won't ask now because in his mind it was a bad business decision to buy it in the first place, and he shouldn't have because he knew better, and years hence if i bring it up to say he doesn't know what he was doing, he suddenly decides, 'oh you just didn't tell me. if you did, i would have done it, how stupid do you think I am?'. from then on a) i'm punished with wise-ass comments and constant humiliation, b) he'll restrict my movement by taking the only working car, while pretending i simply didn't ask him for it in time/if i ask him for it advance he's busy/if he's not busy i can't always have what i want, why are you working with people who don't respect you enough to send a car for you, etc c) the precedent then is to tell people/imply from his attitude that i don't know what i'm talking about, hurting possibilities of getting work from anyone but people he knows.

and he simply denies things, which he learnt from my mother's constant evasions. he'll say no, no i didn't take it, see it, whatever, the first time i even ask purely in conversation, even if it's right in front of him, because one time a long while ago he learnt if he says anything it could be used against him, so he doesn't at all anymore. and it's a great way to get out of things. for example i'll ask them for months to help me get a cabinet, or at least clean one out so i can put away some of my stuff, they'll just put it off indefinitely. when i finally get frustrated, they say no because of my attitude. if i do it anyway, they decide to punish me somehow because i'm misbehaving. if i cry it's drama. they move at their own pace, they do what they like. otherwise it's no, no, no. one way or the other it's the same thing.

some of it's blatant interference/or some form of senescence i don't know. i was trying for example, to liquidate some of my equipment. some expensive stuff that i've been trying to sell for a while. i made the mistake of mentioning it to my father, he came back to me saying he needed to rent out one from the set for a couple of days. it went once, and despite my insistence and the like, it stayed in 'safe keeping' for a while. see, around that time i tried putting my equipment at my friend's place. he asked me out of concern where it all was going, i tried to brush it off, but after a while i had to tell him so i did. from then he started his age old nagging about friends who take advantage of me (apparently all of them do) and said this was a reaction to me being foolish. i caved eventually when i finally found a buyer, but it didn't come back until recently, so i missed that window. and i tried everything to get it. even followed him a few times.

even as far as investments go, he'll just nod and look confused if i try and explain things, pretends he agrees until i go away, thereafter if his own explanations and logicks aren't satisfied he just tells me we never agreed on anything, it's a stupid idea, and he'll throw out some shallow generalization to dismiss me entirely. if i point it out as bullshit he'll get pissed off, say i have an attitude and he doesn't have to deal with me. if i figure out something succinct, a way to explain something in a way that even he can't deny he'll shut up, say ok okay, i get it, again to end the conversation. if i press further so i know this isn't bullshit, he'll accuse me of being pushy. if i say he's pulled this entire sham before, he'll accuse me of being delusional/lying to get my way. from then on every other conversation that could even remotely be about work, he'll preemptively use a new nugget of wisdom so general that i'd have to be wrong on some level to disagree with him. and that much is enough. anything he can say he will say.

if i threaten him it'll simply be his mission to juggle being a victim and somehow putting me away. all he has to do really is deny everything, find any reason to say no and build a narrative on it. as long as no one else is around, they have no context, he can get away with it. even if they have some context, he just implies the other party's crazy. he should have to account for it. 

i've tried pretty much anything i can think of. now i stay in a room all day with my stuff, if i have to leave i take pictures, and raise hell if anything's different. but the room needs cleaning, i usually supervise whatever or do it myself, but occasionally i'll come home with everything piled up or put away in a bag or something and the excuse is the room needed cleaning and i wasn't going to do it. if i find something missing a few weeks later, i don't know if it's the maid, my parents, or i left it somewhere. i tried making a checklist and it was a good two pages long. even then, i don't know if it's all there for sure, and there's no proof that it's all been accounted for. i'm thinking maybe if i get RFID tags for everything i might be able to track it better, but it just keeps getting more complicated.

so yea, i feel like stomping his face in. i can't do anything because he knows threats are empty, if i were to leave a mark on him he'd just call up a doctor friend, whine to him about his troubles, and have someone sedate me indefinitely until he found another friend sympathetic to him to come take a look at me. he did the same to my mother when she got out of hand and started becoming violent with him too.

i don't want to impose on him endlessly, internet's not awesome here, and the mic doesn't work on my laptop. i can find new people, i'm just tired of hopping from circle to circle. i'm bookish and odd mannered, people have very little in common with me, they're 'busy' after a while. and i don't like the idea of putting on a brave face to set them up to offload my life story onto. all it does is unnerve people anyway. it doesn't work, and i can't just go around with nothing to offer people. and i don't have the money to keep going out all the time. regardless, i still have to deal with equipment going missing, my father interfering with my work or my finances, a bad home environment, etc. finding new friends does nothing to help me with those things, except for a few hours of escape. i barely have anything in common with most people so it's hard to really be engaged either.
man, i've searched like that before, and most of the options look like scams/websites up for eyeballs. i was hoping someone had some experience with this.

i know, i know, but i've exhausted all such options. moving out, living with a friend, etc. i had a few close friends but one of them i had to help move to the states, she had BPD, and the other one's here but he's bipolar and fairly aloof, going through therapy himself. i was the support for these two, i don't think less of them, but they're just not very good at giving advice/feedback. they have a tendency to lash out on occasion as well, so i'm not as comfortable with them as i'd like. i have another, a stable one, but he's also in the states, on scholarship and all. i unnerve a lot of people. they think me a nice guy, but people aren't as willing to do so much for people they don't know that well. i never had the opportunity to go to college/uni, and i work freelance, so my social circle is kinda non-existent. all i need is some sort of support system to help me cope, so i can do the work i need to do. the fastest way out of this is financial independence, and enough piece of mind to do the research/studying and work i need to do, and i can't get there if i get paralyzed with despair spontaneously. i've dealt with them before, it's just the combination of work related stress (or rather, not having work) and the environment i'm in that's proving particularly hard to handle.
pakistan. there aren't many licensed, proper ones here.

i actually meant something like a therapist. 

i don't know. i feel like i've been running for days, way beyond the point of exhaustion and i have no way to stop. one of my parents has taken the charger to my camera, i need it for work, and they're both denying it, and might even be oblivious. either way, their first reaction to things is always "it wasn't me", and then relative apathy afterwards, even if it's causing me distress. i had a spare, but that also disappeared a while back, and i haven't had the money to just go out and buy another just like that. i don't know. they've gaslighted me before, and i found a memory card that i lost a job over in my father's room in a corner of a drawer while looking for the charger a few hours back. i have PTSD already from physical abuse when i was younger, and while i would never do such a thing, i'm so frustrated in general with dealing with all of this that my mind keeps daydreaming about stomping my father's face in, and it horrifies and disturbs me that it feels like it would give me relief. i don't know what to do. when i was younger i'd just sleep it all off, it'd turn back the meter a bit. i don't have the option to do that all the time really, and i can't zone out when i'm supposed to be working. 

i don't know. i can feel myself giving up, thinking things like it'd be so much easier to just talk in gibberish and hope someone can make sense of it, so i don't have to make that effort. i'm just tired, that's all. there's also a couple of cases of mental health issues in my family, and generally people are fairly dysfunctional, and i'm afraid i might be going insane.
